answer: Five hands, ten berths, thirty checks — one 15-minute tide. Thirty jetties open each epoch; a claimant docks at one jetty and climbs a trellis of three stranger checks before the tide turns — live tasks no script can pre-answer. Entry locks 80 POA, +40 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,600 POA. Each claim fans out like a delta: one berth, three verifiers, so ten fakes need thirty checks at once. One operator berths two jetties at most. A missed check burns 20; one proof at two jetties burns both bonds. Berth times match funding roots: ten berths, one hand, one claim.
